arguments.summary: Diana, Princess of Wales and Winston Churchill are linked. The shortest backend path is 3 edges: Diana is a child of John Spencer, 8th Earl Spencer, who was educated at the Royal Military College, Sandhurst, where Churchill was also an alumnus. The strongest path is 4 edges and adds real personal weight: Diana's spouse Charles III attended Cheam School, which was also the school of Churchill's father Lord Randolph Churchill, whose child was Winston Churchill — so the stronger route anchors both ends in family/marriage links rather than only shared schooling, though the middle link is still a shared school, not evidence that the two ever met.
